items.html: Indeed, ZA, who takes his Mochin doubled, from the side of Aba and from the side of Ima, then had the Chasadim of Mah and the Chasadim of Ban in Aba, and the Gevurot of Mah and the Gevurot of Ban in Ima. Afterward, when they entered ZA, they were exchanged: the Chasadim of Ban joined with the Gevurot of Ban in the Netzach-Hod-Yesod of Ima, and the Gevurot of Mah joined with the Chasadim of Mah in the Netzach-Hod-Yesod of Aba. It follows that the Mochin of Ima are entirely of Ban, and those of Aba are entirely of Mah.
